function.description: Sends a GET request to the specified URL and retrieves data as specified by the parameters. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

url.description: The URL to which the GET request is sent. It is expected to be a well-formed HTTP or HTTPS URL.

Content-Type.description: The MIME type of the body of the request (used with POST and PUT requests).

Accept.description: The Media type(s) that is/are acceptable for the response.

headers.description: A dictionary of HTTP headers to send with the request. Each key-value pair represents a header name and its value.

timeout.description: The number of seconds to wait for the server to send data before giving up, as a float, or a (connect_timeout, read_timeout) tuple. This is a float type value.

lat.description: Latitude of the location for the query, in degrees. This is a float type value.

lon.description: Longitude of the location for the query, in degrees. This is a float type value.

params.description: Query parameters to append to the URL for the GET request.

allow_redirects.description: Determines if HTTP redirections (301, 302, etc.) should be followed.

auth.description: A tuple representing the user credentials for HTTP authentication, typically in the form of (username, password).

cert.description: Path to an SSL certificate file to verify the peer, or a tuple of (certificate file, key file).

cookies.description: A dictionary of cookies to send with the request. The key is the cookie name and the value is the cookie value.

http.description: URL of the proxy for HTTP requests.

https.description: URL of the proxy for HTTPS requests.

proxies.description: A dictionary mapping protocol names to the URL of the proxy.

stream.description: If True, the response content will not be downloaded immediately but streamed.

verify.description: Whether to verify the server's TLS certificate or not, or a path to a CA bundle if verification is needed.

Sure thing! Here’s a quick rundown of where you can order a cake—whether you’re looking for something local, a specialty dessert, or a quick delivery from a big platform.

---

## 1️⃣ Local Bakeries & Specialty Shops  
| What to Look For | Why It’s Great | How to Order |
|------------------|----------------|--------------|
| **Independent bakeries** | Fresh, often handmade, unique flavors | Call or visit their website; many accept online orders now |
| **Artisan cake shops** | Custom designs, premium ingredients | Book a consultation or use their online design tool |
| **Café‑bakeries** | Great for coffee‑paired cakes | Order in‑store or via their app (e.g., Starbucks, Dunkin’) |

*Tip:* Check reviews on Google Maps or Yelp to find the best local spot. Many bakeries also offer “pick‑up” or “delivery” options.

---

## 2️⃣ Big‑Name Delivery Platforms  
| Platform | What They Offer | How to Order |
|----------|-----------------|--------------|
| **DoorDash / Uber Eats / Postmates** | Wide selection of local bakeries & restaurants | Search “cake” or “dessert” in the app; filter by “Bakeries” |
| **Instacart** | Grocery‑store cakes (e.g., Costco, Walmart) | Add to cart and schedule delivery |
| **Amazon Fresh** | Pre‑made cakes from local vendors | Browse “cakes” under “Bakery” |

*Tip:* These services often have “scheduled delivery” so you can pick a time that works for you.

---

## 3️⃣ Online Cake‑Specialty Sites  
| Site | Highlights | How to Order |
|------|------------|--------------|
| **Etsy** | Handmade, custom‑design cakes from independent bakers | Search “custom cake” + your city; contact seller |
| **CakeBoss** | Custom cakes, 3‑D printing, and themed designs | Use their online builder; choose flavor & size |
| **Bakeology** | Seasonal & themed cakes, often vegan or gluten‑free | Order online; they ship nationwide |

*Tip:* Look for “custom” tags and read the seller’s shipping policy—some only deliver locally.

---

## 4️⃣ Grocery Stores & Supermarkets  
| Store | What They Offer | How to Order |
|-------|-----------------|--------------|
| **Whole Foods** | Fresh, organic cakes; some local bakery partners | Order online via Whole Foods app or website |
| **Trader Joe’s** | Seasonal cakes (often pre‑packaged) | Pick up in‑store or order through Instacart |
| **Costco** | Bulk cakes, often large sizes | Order online or pick up at the warehouse |

*Tip:* Many grocery chains now have “online grocery” sections that include bakery items.

---

## 5️⃣ Specialty & Dietary Options  
| Category | Where to Find | How to Order |
|----------|---------------|--------------|
| **Vegan / Gluten‑Free** | Local vegan bakeries, specialty stores | Search “vegan cake” + city; check ingredient list |
| **Low‑Sugar / Keto** | Health‑food stores, online keto shops | Look for “low‑carb” tags; order online |
| **Allergy‑Friendly** | Allergy‑friendly bakeries (nut‑free, dairy‑free) | Verify allergen info on the site or call |

*Tip:* Always double‑check ingredient lists if you have allergies or dietary restrictions.

---

## 6️⃣ DIY & “Build‑Your‑Own” Options  
| Option | What It Is | How to Order |
|--------|------------|--------------|
| **Cake Mix Kits** | Pre‑measured mix + frosting | Buy on Amazon or local grocery store |
| **Online Cake Builder** | Choose shape, flavor, icing, decorations | Sites like “Cake Boss” let you design a virtual cake |
| **Subscription Boxes** | Monthly cake deliveries | Services like “Cratejoy” or “Treats” offer cake boxes |

*Tip:* These are great if you want to experiment or want a recurring treat.

---

### Quick Checklist Before You Order

1. **Delivery Time** – Make sure the baker can deliver on your desired date/time.  
2. **Size & Flavor** – Confirm the cake size (e.g., 8‑inch, 10‑inch) and flavor.  
3. **Allergens** – Double‑check for nuts, dairy, gluten, etc.  
4. **Payment & Cancellation Policy** – Know how to pay and what the cancellation terms are.  
5. **Reviews** – Read recent customer feedback for quality assurance.

---

#### Need a Recommendation for a Specific City?

If you tell me your city or zip code, I can narrow down the best local bakeries or delivery options for you. Happy cake hunting! 🍰
